verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents CLI, MCP servers, webhooks, and subscription billing, but none of this evidence shows a mechanism for an AI agent to schedule recurring jobs or workflows (e.g., cron-like triggers, scheduled agent runs) — webhooks are event-driven and billing subscriptions are for charging customers, not workflow automation. missing for 10: any documented scheduler/cron feature, recurring workflow triggers for AgentOS/CLI/MCP, or evidence of automated recurring execution of agent tasks.
